ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 252 ADA is an MCB Honors and James Scholars Honors section. Lectures and discussions will begin on Wednesday, January 21, 2020. Examinations will be held from 7:00-9:00PM on the following Tuesday evenings: February 18, March 10, and April 14 2020. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. If you wish to register for this section but are uanble to please email Shawna Naidu at shawna@illinois.edu.
